title: Implement quantity merge rules for aggregated items
description: Add the quantity accumulation logic inside the aggregator so exact-unit numeric quantities sum while mismatched units, text quantities, and quantity-less occurrences remain represented according to spec.
acceptance_criteria: Numeric quantities sum only when both values are `.number` and their units match after lowercasing and trimming, with `nil` matching `nil`.
The retained merged unit uses the canonical lowercased form derived from the first matching numeric occurrence.
Text quantities never merge and remain as separate entries in encounter order.
Quantity-less occurrences do not add `Quantity` entries but still ensure the aggregated item exists, including the all-quantity-less case with an empty `quantities` array.
Mixed quantity-less and quantified occurrences produce one aggregated item whose quantity list reflects only the quantified entries.
No unit conversion, plural normalisation beyond aisle aliases, or recipe-note preservation is introduced.
